reply_text:
Kimi is running; I'm confirming the park carries my session so the wake reaches this buffer.Kimi refused without a requisition line; resending under the clocked mission.㊥ (one interactive infographic) Yes, I think Kimi can do this, so I've handed it to kimi-1 and it's working on it now. The plan is one page where clicking a stage band in the main stream, or its legend entry, opens that stage up into its pattern families in place, with a way back to the all-stages view. Hover readouts and the 21 September marker stay.

㊢ (how it will be checked) Kimi has to write a Playwright check that loads the page in headless Chromium and fails on any script error. That is how the `tokenDataEnd` error got through last time. For each of the eight stages, the check opens it by click and by keyboard, and confirms the number of family bands drawn matches the data. It also checks the back button, hover values, and light and dark themes. The 09-21 page must stay byte-identical. Kimi won't publish; when it reports back, I'll break one stage on purpose to see that the check catches it, run the check myself, look at the screenshots, then publish and give you the URL.

㊩ (one hiccup) My first send was refused because Kimi seats need a requisition line naming a mission. I resent it under M-aif-over-the-operator, the mission your clock shows. If this work belongs under a different mission, tell me and I'll re-file it.

㊢ (tracking) Job `invoke-1790893029289-29903-dcce93af`, park `park-38d969f0-7e9d-494e-80df-435caac0e5db`. If Kimi hasn't reported within an hour, I'll check the job and tell you where it stands.
